'''Farium''' was a heavy metal used in [[Starship/Legends|starship]] hull construction.

After a rich source of farium was found in a deep trench in the oceans of [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]], the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] built the floating city [[Morjanssik]] above this trench. Over sixty percent of its population was involved in mining, processing, or shipping farium.
